summary.tldr: Creates a 30% non-refundable tax credit for certain corporations that buy qualifying heat recovery equipment.
what_it_does: Creates a non-refundable tax credit equal to 30% of the capital cost of qualifying heat recovery equipment bought by a taxable Canadian corporation after December 31, 2025, if required forms are filed on time.
Defines qualifying equipment as unused equipment for use only in Canada that recovers heat from industrial processes and converts it into energy, and is not mainly used to generate energy.
Reduces the credit for non-government assistance, and adds rules for later repayment of assistance, partnership allocations, and limited partners.
Adds a recapture rule, if the equipment is converted to another use, exported, or disposed of within the next five calendar years, the credit is added back to tax.
Excludes equipment that is a tax shelter investment, and makes related changes to the Income Tax Act to fit the new credit.
summary.background: It amends the Income Tax Act to add a new heat recovery tax credit.
